violated_contract: A post-chat quota refresh must not infer hosted-request completion from a shared busy flag whose lifecycle is also controlled by local automation, coding-agent, cancellation, and reset paths.
canonical_prevention: Publish an explicit hosted-dispatch event only after the managed-cloud adapter writes its provider command, expose a monotonic completion signal from the chat hook, and consume that signal at the quota-trigger host through the canonical main-chat quota gate.
